17.o: Min Joon Gook lures Hye Sung into his trap by lying that he kidnapped Soo Ha.

18.o: Min Joon Gook promises to tell his whole story if Gwan Woo agrees to become his defense attorney again.

1.o: في عام 1977، يجد مفاوض الرهائن الفيدرالي المُحبط "هولدن فورد" في العميل المخضرم "بيل تينش" خير حليف، ويبدآن دراسة فئة جديدة من القتلة.

2.o: يحاور "هولدن" القاتلَ ذا الدقة المثيرة للقلق "إد كيمبر"، لكن بحثه يثير ردود أفعال سلبية في مكتب التحقيقات الفيدرالي.

3.o: تنضم الطبيبة "ويندي كار" إلى "هولدن" و"تينش" في أولى نجاحاتهما، عندما تمهّد ملاحظاتهما الطريق إلى عملية اعتقال ناجحة.

4.o: يتشاور "بيل" و"هولدن" مع الطبيبة "ويندي كار" لبدء تصنيف مجرميهم، ثم يتلقيان أنباءً مفاجئة.

5.o: يعود "هولدن" و"بيل" إلى قضية معقدة وقعت في "بنسلفانيا"، حيث لا تُقلل مجموعة من الأدلة التي تشير إلى اتجاهات عدة من عدد المشتبه بهم.

6.o: تفكر "ويندي" في عرض، بينما يجتهد "هولدن" و"بيل" لتوصيل مغزى ما توصّلا إليه من نتائج إلى النظام القضائي في قضية بلدة "ألتونا" المحيرة.

7.o: تأخذ "ويندي" مخاطرة مهنية بالانتقال والانضمام للعمل مع الفريق بدوام كامل، ويجد "هولدن" و"بيل" صعوبة في تفادي الانهماك العاطفي في العمل.

8.o: يحاور "بيل" و"ويندي" مرشحين جدد لشغل وظيفة رابعة في الفريق، بينما تثير بعض الشكاوى بشأن عادة غريبة لمدير إحدى المدارس اهتمام "هولدن".

9.o: تتسبب طرق "هولدن" أثناء حوار مزعج مع السفّاح "ريتشارد سبيك" في خلاف بين الفريق وفتح تحقيق داخل مكتب التحقيقات الفيدرالي.

10.o: يتصدّع الفريق تحت ضغط عملية مراجعة من المكتب، وينتزع أسلوب "هولدن" الجريء اعترافًا... لكنه يعرّض مهنته وعلاقاته وصحته للخطر.

1.o: وسط التغيرات الكبيرة الجارية في "قسم العلم السلوكي"، يواجه "هولدن" تداعياتٍ خطيرةً ناجمةً عن اللقاء الذي يجمعه عن قرب بـ"إد كيمبر"، فما هي؟

2.o: يُجري "بيل" و"هولدن" مقابلة مع "ابن" للتوصل إلى رؤية متعمّقة عن القاتل المراوغ "بي تي كيه"، فيفاجئهم "ابن" باعتراف مُثير للدهشة.

3.o: يُزَجّ بـ"بيل" في وحل جريمة مروّعة تمسّ حياته الشخصية. أما "هولدن"، فيتلقى عرضًا مغريًا وهو في "أتلانتا" لاستجواب قاتلَين، فما هو هذا العرض؟

4.o: يضع "هولدن" وصفًا مثيرًا للجدل لمرتكب جرائم القتل في "أتلانتا"، وتُجري "ويندي" أول مقابلة، فتكتشف أن وجودها في الصفوف الأولى يناسبها تمامًا.

5.o: يُلقي موقف عائلة "بيل" العصيب بظلاله على مقابلة "بيل" مع هدف "هولدن" المنشود "تشارلز مانسون"، فيما تشتعل علاقة "ويندي" الرومانسية الجديدة.

6.o: توفد المباحث الفيدرالية "قسم العلم السلوكي" إلى "أتلانتا" للتحقيق في مقتل أطفال واختفائهم، وتفكر "ويندي" مجددًا في أساليب إجرائها للمقابلات.

7.o: بعد الوصول لطريق مسدود، يقترح "هولدن" خطة جريئة للإيقاع بالقاتل، وتخضع عائلة "بيل" لمزيد من المراقبة، فيما تغضب "ويندي" من تغيير مسار عملها.

8.o: يعيق الروتين خطة "هولدن" لتضييق دائرة المشتبه بهم، ويحاول "بيل" المنهك الحزين أن يتقرب من ابنه، فيما تعيد "ويندي" النظر في علاقتها الغرامية.

9.o: تركز التحقيقات على مشتبه به رئيسي، والذي يفاجئ الجميع بعبقريته في التلاعب بموقف مضطرب واستغلاله لصالحه.

1.t: I Only Need a Little Brother Who Can Cook, a Beautiful Naked Girl, and Friends I Can Relate to
1.o: Itsuki Hashima is a popular, young novelist. However, he is obsessed with little sisters and his works seem to always include little sisters, so there’s some difficulty coming up with a new series. One day, his younger step-brother Chihiro and his colleagues, Hayato Fuwa, Nayuta Kani, and fellow college student, Miyako Shirakawa show up at his apartment. They enjoy dinner, drinks, and a game. That night, Nayuta makes advances towards Itsuki, but...

2.t: If Only a Miracle Would Happen
2.o: Nayuta and Miyako walk in on Itsuki, who was naked in front of the bathroom mirror, trying to act out the little sister character in his new volume. Itsuki is everything to Nayuta, and Miyako secretly has some feelings for Itsuki, but Nayuta also cherishes Miyako because she showed her compassion in her time of need. Nayuta invites Miyako to the hotel she’s staying at and immediately gets naked. She then asks Miyako to also get naked for some kind of research for her novel...

3.t: As Long As It's For Research
3.o: Itsuki, Nayuta, and Miyako have a hard time dealing with the cold and head down to Okinawa. The next day, they visit a remote island so Itsuki can do some research and Nayuta decides to flail around naked in the water. Miyako is awed by what she's seeing and eventually jumps into the water naked, as well. Two days later, Itsuki is invited by his illustrator to go to Hokkaido, where they try various local cuisines. However, Itsuki finds out that Setsuna had been ignoring a deadline...

4.o: Nayuta, Miyako and Haruto gather at Itsuki’s room for Valentine’s Day, and Haruto tries to show off his friendship with Itsuki again. Toki then shows up with the chocolates that fans had sent to them. A few days later, a new face shows up at Itsuki’s house. Itsuki was getting ready to do his final return for his taxes and all of his possessions are carefully inspected by the new figure...

5.t: All You Need Is to Write Novels.
5.o: Itsuki is nearing his final deadline for volume 5 and flees from his editor, Toki, however he is immediately caught. However, Itsuki manages to escape when he runs into Setsuna and they both go to a hot springs. Setsuna felt like he was in a slump and wanted to see some asses to get some inspiration. But when they get to the ryokan with the hot springs, Itsuki witnesses something horrifying...

6.t: Having Your Media Developments Go Well Is All You Need.
6.o: Itsuki has a meeting with Kaiko Mikuniyama, the manga artist who will be doing the manga version of “Mahou Academy.” She looks very refined, which makes Itsuki nervous, but apparently she loves little sisters as much as he does. The group has a little celebration to celebrate the upcoming broadcast of Haruto’s anime and the manga version of Itsuki’s series. The group gets together once again to watch the broadcast of the first anime episode live, but…

7.o: In order to cheer Haruto up after his anime was such a flop, Itsuki gets him as well as Nayuta, Miyako and Chihiro together so they can play a TRPG. Itsuki usually plays girls in games, but for some reason, Chihiro makes out their character to be Itsuki’s character’s little sister, which leads to Nayuta and Miyako also making their characters sisters of the other two. Haruto becomes the GM and does whatever he wants.

8.t: All You Need Is Love and Friendship.
8.o: After Haruto tells him how he feels about Miyako, Itsuki promises to help him out. Around the same time, Nayuta, who sees Miyako as an older sister, tells him that she wants to have a birthday party for her. Itsuki and Nayuta have difficulties trying to figure out what to get Miyako for her birthday, so Nayuta asks her who her favorite author is, and she responds with Itsuki. Nayuta feels jealousy toward Itsuki for the first time, since they’re both authors. What was the gift that Nayuta ended up getting Miyako?

9.t: Nudity and Underwear Are All You Need.
9.o: Toki brings Itsuki the manuscript for the Mahou Academy manga. Itsuki was looking forward to what Kaiko had drawn because of her art quality, but there was a problem. Itsuki is unable to get over this problem and goes to confront Kaiko. Setsuna then shows up and has a manga battle with Kaiko on who will do the manga version of Itsuki’s book.

10.t: A Lack of Problems Is All You Need.
10.o: Chihiro starts working part time at Ashley’s office. Chihiro cleans Ashley’s whole office and then goes to take a bath and Ashley finds out Chihiro’s “secret.” Meanwhile, Itsuki heads to the zoo with Nayuta so he can do some research for his next book and they observe all the naked animals. He then goes to the aquarium with Chihiro and then takes Chihiro home in a taxi and...

11.t: Becoming the Protagonist Is All You Need.
11.o: Itsuki asks Miyako to take something to the publisher’s for him and she runs into Nayuta’s editor. Miyako tells her that she will go see Nayuta and get her to finish the manuscript in person, and her editor thanks her. Miyako then realizes that she might want to be an editor herself. To celebrate his new volume being released, Itsuki has his friends come over and they all play the game “Once Upon a Time” and chaos ensues.

12.o: Itsuki falls asleep at the kotatsu and has a dream. He dreams about his darker middle school days. His mother had just died and he falls in love with a certain girl, but... Back in modern time, Itsuki celebrates his book becoming an anime and has a mixer at his apartment. Haruto brings over a board game about being a light novel artist and they all play. What kind of results will they all get in the end?

8.o: It's the home stretch for Caplan, Walter and Roxanne. At the end of this path of extreme justice that they've carved themselves, with their noblest intentions, love, family and death await them. And they will all pay a heavy price.

1.o: The loser of a kids-channel contest gets akumatized by Hawk Moth. Now Stormy Weather, she takes revenge on those who did not vote for her.  Dark skies await for our superheroes!

2.o: Adrien's best friend, Nino, is akumatized into the Bubbler, a villain who traps adults in bubbles and sends them floating away into the atmosphere.

3.o: When a villain with the power of the ancient Egyptian gods wants to sacrifice Alya, Ladybug and Cat Noir must fight an army of mummies to rescue her.

4.o: Mistakenly believing that Chloé is Ladybug, Alya gets expelled from school for her nosiness and becomes akumatized into the villain Lady Wifi.

5.o: When anger over a broken watch turns Alix into a time-traveling villain, it's up to Ladybug to return to the past and thwart her plans.

6.o: The akuma fighters try to apprehend Mr. Pigeon, a bird lover who has kidnapped all the park keepers in Paris, but Cat Noir's allergies interfere.

7.o: A fellow student with a crush on Marinette is akumatized into the Evillustrator, a villain that Cat Noir must face without Ladybug.

8.o: When he's fired by the mayor, police officer Roger becomes Rogercop, a villain who thinks he's enforcing the law by ruling Paris as a dictator.

9.o: A jealous sculptor in love with Ladybug akumatizes into Copycat, a duplicate of Cat Noir who tries to take his rival's place by Ladybug's side.

10.o: Marinette considers declaring her feelings to Adrien for Valentine's Day, but first they must stop Dark Cupid, a villain bent on eradicating love.

11.o: During the filming of a short horror movie for Marinette's class, scared star Mylène is akumatized into a slimy monster that feeds on others' fears.

12.o: While Marinette tries to retrieve her diary from Chloé, Adrien's fencing teacher is akumatized into Darkblade, a villain who storms city hall.

13.o: When Mylène's father loses a part in a play to his scheming understudy, he akumatizes into the Mime, a villain whose pantomimes become real.

14.o: When his dish at a competition is sabotaged, Marinette's great-uncle chef Wang Cheng becomes Kung Food, who recruits henchmen with his cooking.

15.o: Marinette beats Adrien's video game tournament partner, Max, so she can replace him and spend time with her crush, but Max akumatizes into a villain.

16.o: A humiliated zookeeper is akumatized into a villainous shapeshifting animal on a day when Marinette, Adrien and friends are visiting the zoo in Paris.

17.o: Crestfallen when her hero Ladybug refuses to heed her advice, Chloé akumatizes into Antibug, an evil twin of Ladybug with identical powers.

18.o: Marinette babysits little Manon, who becomes akumatized into the Puppeteer while playing with dolls of Ladybug, Cat Noir and some infamous villains.

19.o: Excluded from a class photo, dejected Juleka akumatizes into the villain Reflekta, who turns everyone, including Cat Noir, into copies of herself.

20.o: Rock star Jagged Stone is akumatized into a supervillain who tries to transform all Parisians into fans and undermine his musical rival, Mr. XY.

21.o: Rejected by a rock star, an angry fan becomes Pixelator, who traps Parisians in his camera's memory until Cat Noir and Ladybug halt his photo spree.

22.o: Marinette can't transform into Ladybug when classmate Rose is akumatized into a villain whose perfume lets her control Cat Noir and a visiting prince.

23.o: A hypnotist akumatizes into Simon Says, a villain who can make anyone obey him with his deck of cards, and seeks revenge on Adrien's father.

24.o: After Ladybug exposes her lies in front of Adrien, Lila, a new student, becomes akumatized and poses as a superhero.

25.o: In a flashback, Ladybug and Cat Noir's origins are revealed, as Marinette befriends Alya and meets Adrien, a famous model with an overprotective dad.

26.o: In a continuing flashback to Ladybug and Cat Noir's origins, Marinette mistakes Adrien for a bully and hesitates to embrace her Ladybug persona.

1.o: After Marinette mixes up some messages, an old love of Master Fu becomes Backwarder, who wields a magic wand that can steal time from others.

2.o: Disappointed that Cat Noir doesn't return his daughter's love, Tom becomes Weredad, who locks Marinette in a magic prison to protect her from hurt.

3.o: Marinette and Adrien confront Lila with her lies, so she asks Hawk Moth to akumatize her into Chameleon, a new villain determined to destroy Ladybug.

4.o: Humiliated at the premiere of his new Ladybug and Cat Noir movie, the director becomes Animaestro, forcing the real superheroes to act fast.

5.o: Marinette meets her grumpy grandpa for the first time, leading him to akumatize into a villain who wants to destroy everything modern in Paris.

6.o: Marinette and Kitty Section record a music video, but an unscrupulous producer, the father of XY, steals their ideas and inspires Luka to seek revenge.

7.o: When they enter the Montparnasse Tower, Ladybug and Cat Noir lose their memories and transform back into Marinette and Adrien in front of each other.

8.o: Ladybug and Cat Noir must fight Aurore Boreale when she is akumatized again into Stormy Weather 2, who wants to plunge the world into endless winter.

9.o: Ladybug and Cat Noir each get the other's Miraculous when they must take on Juleka, who has become Reflekta again and now has a sentimonster.

10.o: Kagami becomes jealous when Lila manipulates her way into the Agreste mansion and turns into Oni-Chan, a masked villain who can teleport.

11.o: Sabrina, angry at Chloe for the attention she gives to Ladybug, becomes Miraculer, who can steal powers away from superheroes.

12.o: Marinette tries to arrange some alone time with Adrien at the wax museum, but she's supposed to be babysitting Manon, who becomes Puppeteer again.

13.o: Jagged Stone seeks to replace the guitarist he fired, who akumatizes into Desperada, a villain with a magic guitar that turns people into stickers.

14.o: Anxiously awaiting news about her astronaut application, Max's mom becomes Startrain, who wants to turn her train into a rocket ship.

15.o: Mrs. Mendeleiev discovers Plagg and Tikki and plans to reveal the existence of the kwamis on a TV show until she is akumatized into Kwami Buster.

16.o: A strange statue uncovered in Tibet turns out to be a sentimonster called Feast that was created accidentally by Master Fu when he was a child.

17.o: Adrien is the prize in a Paris-wide Friendship Day treasure hunt, but Marinette is teamed up with Kagami, who has disobeyed her mother to participate.

18.o: Ladybug and Cat Noir are trapped between two time travelers from the future, one of whom has been sent by Hawk Moth to steal their Miraculous.

19.o: After Adrien tells his friend Wayem he's not allowed to have friends over, Wayem discovers an impromptu party at the Agrestes that makes him jealous.

20.o: When he can't find anyone to test his video game that pits formerly akumatized villains against one another, Max again becomes one himself: Gamer 2.0.

21.o: Marinette uses her powers to leave a gift for Adrien, causing him to realize her secret identity -- which has a devastating impact on the future.

22.o: Marinette reveals her feelings for Adrien on the anniversary of his mom's death, but his lookalike cousin pretends to be Adrien and responds cruelly.

23.o: Marinette's scheming nemesis Lila manipulates all of her friends into turning against her and even gets Marinette expelled from school.

24.o: Marinette babysits Nino's little brother, Chris, who akumatizes into Chris Master and wields a magic snow globe that can make giant toys.

25.t: Heart Hunter (The Battle of the Miraculous – Part 1)
25.o: At a celebration for their twentieth anniversary, the Bourgeois couple is akumatized into Hearthunter, a two-headed Cerberus that devours love.

26.t: Miracle Queen (The Battle of the Miraculous – Part 2)
26.o: Hawk Moth changes Chloe into Miracle Queen and conquers Paris, forcing Miraculous wearers to reveal themselves -- but Ladybug and Cat Noir escape.

1.o: A friend of Marinette's gets akumatized into Truth. Using his power to force people to tell the truth, he wants to know Marinette's secret.

2.o: A friend of Adrien's gets akumatized into Lies and becomes determined to rid the world of lies and those who tell them.

3.o: Marinette's friends get akumatized into the Gang of Secrets, a team of supervillains determined to save her.

4.o: Mr. Ramier gets akumatized into Mr. Pigeon for the 72nd time, and now he can turn people into evil pigeons.

5.o: Ladybug and Cat Noir face someone they know well, and never imagined they would have to fight someday.

6.o: A newcomer to Marinette's circle of friends gets akumatized into Sole Crusher, a humongous supervillain who can absorb people.

7.o: Chloe is akumatized into Queen Banana and Ladybug decides to entrust a Miraculous to help her stop a supervillain.

8.o: When Reflekta becomes entangled in a bottomless abyss of guilt, Ladybug calls an ally for help with unshakable optimism.

9.o: Because of a plan thought up by Marinette, Shadow Moth akumatizes two villains. Ladybug and Cat Noir will need help to stop the evil duo.

10.o: What would happen if Shadow Moth created a fearsome supervillain while Marinette and Adrien couldn't transform into Ladybug and Cat Noir?

11.o: Shadow Moth creates Sentibubbler, a fearsome sentimonster that will only stop if Rena Rouge betrays Ladybug and Cat Noir!

12.o: As Guardian of Miraculous, Ladybug must make difficult decisions which affect the people around her. But not everyone is ready to live in permanent hiding like her...

13.o: When Malediktator comes back, now seconded by a Sentimonster, Ladybug entrusts a committed friend and ally with a Miraculous to help her save Paris.

14.o: As Marinette thinks about her future, a supervillain shows up in Paris. Able to force people to live their childhood dreams, he turns into a nightmare for our heroes.

15.o: When Marinette needs to leave Paris for a day for her aunt's birthday in London, the fear of something happening in Ladybug's absence makes her super nervous. Shadow Moth manages to infect Max's robot with an evil virus to akumatize it again. What will happen?

16.o: Adrien asks Marinette a favor, who can't say no and ends up leaving her grandfather taking care of the 4 children she was taking care of to help Adrien. What she doesn't realize is that it ends up making her grandfather the Shadow Moth's next target.

17.o: Ladybug and Cat Noir face Glaciator again. Glaciator annoys Ladybug by insisting that the superheroes are in love. Cat Noir encounters Marinette, who wrestles with secret romance.

18.o: Galette Day is eventful for Marinette! Tikki is acting very strange and three supervillains show up! Will Ladybug still manage to establish herself as queen of the day?

19.o: Ladybug decides whether she should reveal Cat Noir's identity so that she can remain the Guardian.

20.o: Marinette sneaks into the Agreste home during a private dinner, only to find that a supervillain is also crashing the party.

21.o: A famous comedian gets akumatized into Psycomedian; able to impose any emotions on anyone, he wants to wipe the smiles off everyone's faces starting with Ladybug and Cat Noir.

22.o: Ladybug manages to assemble an amazing team of superheroes now that she is Guardian of the Miraculous, but Cat Noir is feeling left out and decides to give up his Miraculous. Ladybug now needs to deliver the Cat Miraculous to someone else.

23.o: When one of Shadow Moth's favorite victims is akumatized into Penalteam, a fearsome team of supervillains, Ladybug calls on her own superhero team in order to face her; may the best team win.

24.o: Because one of Marinette's careless mistakes, one of her closet relatives is akumatized into Qilin, a fearsome supervillain.

25.o: Without Ladybug and Cat Noir knowing, Shadow Moth patiently sets his final attack in motion...

26.o: Shadow Moth's trap closes in on Ladybug and Cat Noir, threatening to turn their fate upside down forever...

1.o: Willy Fog hires Rigodon, a former circus performer, to replace the butler he dismissed the previous day and, unknowingly, hires Rigodon's friend, Tico, at the same time. Later, Fog tells his fellows at London's Reform Club that he has read an article which suggests one can travel around the world in eighty days. To prove to his skeptical colleagues that this is possible, he wagers half his £40,000 fortune that he can make the journey.

2.o: As Fog, Rigodon and Tico begin their journey, Mr Sullivan (one of the four who bet against Fog) hires a cunning master of disguise known as Transfer to sabotage the expedition. Meanwhile, Inspector Dix and Constable Bully of Scotland Yard discover that Fog matches the description of the suspect in a recent robbery at the Bank of England and are sent to trail him.

3.o: Transfer, disguised as a French lady, attempts to lead Fog and his party astray in Paris, only to be thwarted by Rigodon and Tico in the woods on the outskirts of the city. As a result, Fog learns of Tico's presence in his party.

4.o: During a stopover in Suez, Transfer steals Fog's passport and lures the travellers to a ruined temple. This episode marks the first appearance of Tico's sun-clock, which features in all but one of the subsequent episodes.

5.o: While sailing to India, Fog and his party meet Brigadier Corn, who is on his way to rejoin his regiment in Benares and travels with them throughout most of their adventures in India. Meanwhile, Transfer's latest scheme involves disguising himself as Fog, in order to break into the latter's cabin.

6.o: His previous attempt to pose as Fog thwarted, Transfer tries again when the travellers arrive in Bombay. However, his disguise is so convincing that Dix and Bully arrest him, thinking he is the real Fog. Meanwhile, Tico and Rigodon's curiosity lands them in trouble with a local religious order.

7.o: Fog and his party learn that the railway linking Bombay and Calcutta is still under construction, forcing them to trek through the jungle to Allahabad. Transfer quickly takes advantage of the situation and, posing as a local guide, starts leading Fog and his party into the jungle on a stolen elephant.

8.o: Transfer tries to leave Fog and his party (whom he has been leading in the wrong direction) stranded in the jungle, only to be thwarted by the elephant he stole.

9.o: The travellers encounter the beautiful Princess Romy, who is due to be burned on her late husband's funeral pyre. Fog is determined to save her, but, in order to do so, he and the others must risk being captured and killed themselves.

10.o: The travellers escape from the jungle and cross paths with the elephant's rightful owner, who agrees to take them to Allahabad. Meanwhile, Romy recovers from her ordeal and, fearing she will be hunted down if she stays in India, agrees to leave the country with Fog and his party.

11.o: Shortly after arriving in Calcutta, Rigodon and Tico are arrested and charged with desecrating the temple they were chased out of in Bombay. Fog must now do everything in his power to free them before the Rangoon, the ship which will take the travellers on the next leg of their journey, sets sail.

12.o: Romy is searching for the uncle and aunt she has not seen for several years and traces them to Hong Kong. But, while she and the others are sailing there, they find themselves in the path of a typhoon.

13.o: Learning that her uncle and aunt have died, a grief-stricken Romy agrees to travel to England with Fog and his party. Meanwhile, since Hong Kong is the last outpost of the British Empire Fog will pass through before returning to England, Dix is determined to detain him as long as possible and tries to enlist Rigodon's help to do so. Then, to further complicate matters, Transfer diguises himself as Dix.

14.o: Drugged by Transfer, Rigodon and Tico awaken to find themselves on the steamship Carnatic, at the mercy of the master of disguise, who is impersonating the ship's stoker. Meanwhile, left behind in Hong Kong, Fog and Romy search for another ship to take them to Japan, in addition to searching for their missing companions.

15.o: Finding themselves stranded in Yokohama, Rigodon and Tico seek work in a local circus to raise the money they need to get home, while Fog and Romy (who have also arrived in Japan) continue to search for them.

16.o: Fog and his party are sailing across the Pacific for San Francisco on the steamship General Grant. When they are forced to make an unscheduled stop in Hawaii, the travellers learn that an island princess is dangerously ill. Romy volunteers to try and save the princess, but the travellers will all be killed if her attempts fail.

17.o: Transfer sets fire to the General Grant's sails, forcing the ship to dock in Mexico while repairs are carried out. Shortly afterwards, a hot-air balloon crashes into the ship and Fog (who must cover more than 400 miles in one day) buys it from the pilot. But, as the travellers prepare to take off, Dix (who has a plan to gain Fog's confidence) and Bully hitch a ride.

18.o: Arriving in San Francisco, the travellers experience their first taste of life in the Wild West, while Transfer enlists the help of the Dingo Kid and his gang of outlaws to lure Fog into a fight.

19.o: As Fog and the others travel across America by train, Transfer attempts to use the wild terrain against them. When he sabotages the bridge across Medicine Bow Gorge, Fog is forced to take a desperate gamble by attempting to direct the train across the bridge at maximum speed.

20.o: The train is attacked by American Indians, but Fog, Rigodon, Dix and Bully manage to drive them off. Shortly afterwards, however, Transfer (disguised as one of the Indians) attacks the train's driver and stoker, sending the train careering out of control. Rigodon and Tico, sent to investigate, end up being captured by Indians and, though the train is eventually brought back under control, Fog is not prepared to continue travelling without them.

21.o: The travellers are reunited and must now travel across over 100 miles of rough terrain to reach Omaha. Transfer leads a gang of outlaws in an ambush on a stage-coach whose driver has found the travellers on the prairie and agreed to take them to their destination.

22.o: With the railway system linking Chicago and Buffalo closed due to heavy snow, Fog and the others plan to cross the Great Lakes in an ice-boat. But, during the trip, Tico is taken ill, forcing the travellers to seek shelter in a log cabin until he has recovered.

23.o: Having just missed the ship in which they had planned to sail home, the travellers book passage on the Henrietta, a cargo ship bound for Bordeaux, even though, by not sailing directly to England, they risk missing their deadline. But, when the ship's captain, Andrew Speedy, falls victim to one of Transfer's traps and needs medical attention, he orders Fog to head for the nearest port. As luck would have, the nearest port is Liverpool, Fog's intended destination.

24.o: When the Henrietta's coal supply is exhausted fighting a hurricane, Fog buys the ship, intending to use the wood on board as fuel. By the end of the episode, nothing remains of the ship except a metal framework.

25.o: On arriving in Liverpool, Dix tells Fog he is under arrest. Though Fog is soon freed (since the real bank-robber is already in custody) he and the others have only a few hours to reach London - and the only train available is a freight train.

26.t: What A Difference A Day Makes
26.o: Fog has narrowly lost the bet and, with it, most of what remains of his fortune after all the expenses incurred on the trip. But, then, Romy asks him to marry her; Fog accepts and, while Rigodon and Tico are taking care of the arrangements, they learn that, having failed to account for crossing the International Date Line, they believe it to be a day later than it actually is. There follows a race against time to reach the Reform Club before the deadline actually expires.

1.o: The drama tells the story of a female chief from a mysterious primitive tribe and an elite urban man from the city. The two are completely different “species” who meet unexpectedly and “tame” each other.

Derrick Campana specializes in designing prosthetics and orthotic braces for animals. Derrick will fit Jabu, an elephant in Botswana with a life-threatening injury, with the world's first elephant orthotic leg brace, hoping to save his life.

2.o: Ali Bee, her husband Tim, and daughter Izzy spend their time rescuing and rehabilitating koalas in their home in Australia. Crikey the koala was a baby that was found alone and very sick. Now, it's time for the family to release him into the wild.

3.t: Pen and the Dogs of War
3.o: British Marine Pen Farthing is the founder of Nowzad, Afghanistan's only official animal sanctuary. When a U.S. soldier rescues six puppies while deployed and can't bring them home, Pen and his team are on a mission to get them reunited in Texas.

4.t: Jan and Tim’s Greatest Show On Earth
4.o: Animal Defenders International (ADI), led by Jan Creamer and Tim Phillips, has already helped ban the animal circus industry in over 40 countries. When their organization arrives in Peru, they embark on their biggest animal rescue challenge yet.

5.o: Katherine Connor and her children run an elephant sanctuary that rescues, rehabilitates, and re-wilds elephants from Thailand's tourism and logging industries. Now she wants to rescue an older elephant, Pang Fai, and release her from chains forever.

6.o: Chimp expert Estelle Raballand has formed an incredible bond with Ponso, a chimp who lives alone on an island and has been dubbed the loneliest chimp in the world.  She's determined to find him a companion and thinks she has found the perfect match.

1.o: A soldier from 1569, a female college student from 1880 and a modern-day paramedic must prevent two Frenchmen in 1808 from altering a war's outcome.

2.o: The patrol travels to Lisbon in 1588 to stop Lope de Vega from dying before he writes his greatest works.

3.o: The Ministry sends agents to 1940 after a man being chased by Nazis promises to show Heinrich Himmler how to travel in time if he'll spare his life.

4.o: Ordered to pay millions for the death of the rabbi who wrote the Book of Doors, the Ministry sends the trio to 1491 to prevent his execution for heresy.

5.t: Any Time in the Past Was Better
5.o: The patrol must go to 1981 Madrid to find a copy of a missing bill of sale for Picasso's "Guernica" to ensure the masterpiece is returned to Spain.

6.o: The patrol meets the novella-inspiring Lazarillo de Tormes while visiting 1520 Salamanca to capture a fugitive hiding from the law via time travel.

7.o: The patrol travels to 1844 to stop the assassination of Isabel II at the hands of a Ministry rebel, and the disappearance of the Ministry altogether.

8.o: When the Ministry learns a young Salvador Dalí has designed a film poster in 1924 featuring a tablet computer, the patrol is sent to investigate.

1.o: The Ministry travels to the 11th century to solve a mystery involving the burial remains of El Cid. Julián faces the consequences of his actions.

2.o: Pacino, a police officer who's been missing since 1981, reappears in the present and finds out he's now a suspect in the crime he was investigating.

3.o: Pacino joins the team for the first time as they work to ensure that Miguel de Cervantes publishes "Don Quixote" in 1604.

4.o: Spain's transition from a dictatorship to a democracy is in jeopardy when the life of a crucial Spanish politician's ancestor is threatened.

5.o: Irene contracts the Spanish flu while on a mission in 1918. Susana insists she be brought back to the present, putting the entire Ministry at risk.

6.o: The team travels to 1920s New York, into the world of magic and Houdini, as the Ministry's own existence is placed in peril.

7.o: While hiding out in the Philippines in the 19th century, Julián makes a promise to a dying soldier that gets him into a dangerous situation.

8.o: Salvador sends Alonso on a mission to save Julián from a lengthy battle during the Siege of Baler in the Philippines.

9.o: A Velázquez painting is auctioned off in 2016. The only problem is it burned in a 1734 fire. The team heads to the Alcázar of Madrid to investigate.

10.o: Irene looks into a mystery involving a group of avant-garde women artists who've been forgotten. The Ministry discovers the Vampire of Raval is free.

11.o: On a tour of the Ministry, redesigned to look like a regular office, a suspicious paranormal expert barges past a barrier and through one of the doors.

12.o: Ortigosa and Natalia's wedding is complicated by a hidden time portal and a romantic legend from the 13th century.

13.o: Phillip II of Spain decides he wants the Spanish Armada to win in 1588. He gets a taste for time travel and sets his sights higher, focusing on 2016.

1.o: Mourning a loss, the patrol is sent to foil a plan to kidnap Alfred Hitchcock during the premiere of "Vertigo" at the 1958 San Sebastián Film Festival.

2.o: A Spanish spy's capture in Nazi-occupied France in 1943 jeopardizes Britain's Operation Mincemeat, critical to the Allied victory of World War II.

3.o: When Gustavo Adolfo Bécquer writes one too many "Letters from My Cell," the patrol travels to 1864 Trasmoz, where a woman is accused of witchcraft.

4.o: In the present-day Prado Museum, an invisible force slashes Goya's "Nude Maja," sending the Ministry to 1799 to convince the artist to repaint it.

5.o: The trio travels to 1605 Valladolid after the attempted poisoning of a British envoy threatens the signing of a peace treaty between Spain and England.

6.o: An 1881 assassination attempt on Alfonso XII pulls the agents into Spain's slave-trading past, forcing one to choose between family and the Ministry.

7.o: When Luis Buñuel's "Viridiana" fails to pass Francoist censorship, Irene travels to 1961 with Pacino and Alonso to ensure the film wins at Cannes.

8.o: The disappearance of a Spanish priest key to Hernán Cortés's conquest of Mexico sends Alonso and Pacino to the 16th-century Yucatán Peninsula.

9.o: To find a portal to the future, the Exterminating Angel abducts Abraham Levi, who escapes to 1417 Peñíscola and begs Antipope Benedict XIII for help.

10.o: Moorish refugees from 1609 inundate the Ministry headquarters. Alonso and Pacino must stop an assassination plot against Simón Bolívar in 1828 Bogotá.

11.o: A cancellation of the premiere of "La Verbena de la Paloma" sends three Ministry workers to 1894. Alonso interrogates Arteche, who tells his life story.

12.o: The patrol is dispatched to 1976 after learning that Adolfo Suárez is not among the candidates for prime minister of Spain.

13.o: The 1966 debut of a TV series about the Ministry of Time threatens to prevent Chicho Ibáñez Serrador's "Historias para no dormir" from ever premiering.

1.o: The patrol is reunited after three years to investigate a debuting actor who looks exactly like Julián, who was believed to have been killed in action.

2.o: Alonso and Irene travel to the 1600s to the royal court of Philip IV. Meanwhile, Pacino and Lola must ensure that Pedro Almodóvar casts Antonio Banderas in his film "Labyrinth of Passion" in 1981.

3.o: As the patrol makes its way to England to prevent Elizabeth I from being murdered before ever being crowned queen, Amelia returns to the Ministry to help Julián.

4.o: Two teams are sent to 1937: Julian and Lola go to Madrid to investigate possible theft of Velazquez's Las Meninas. Pacino, Irene, and Velazquez go to Paris to ensure that Picasso paints Guernica.

5.o: After Lola is kidnapped, Pacino decides to alter the past to save her - but messing with the timeline comes at a high price.

6.o: When Albert Einstein is murdered in Madrid and his friend and fellow scientist Emilio Herrera is the prime suspect, Salvador takes matters into his own hands.

7.o: In 1832, King Ferdinand VII is being poisoned. The Ministry takes him to 2020 for medical treatment and replaces him with a stand-in, but they must ensure no one discovers the switch.

8.o: A dead body of a one-year-old is found near the Ministry's headquarters. As Salvador confesses to the crime, he offers an explanation by telling a tale of how Julian found himself in the year 2070.

1.o: Marta's family and friends describe the night she went missing and the subsequent search that ensued as they grew suspicious of her ex, Miguel.

2.o: The search for Marta's body continues as Miguel and the other suspects change their versions of what happened the night she was killed.

3.o: The suspects stand trial for Marta's murder and the ensuing coverup. Her parents explain their desire to find her body. Plus, new evidence is analyzed.

1.o: January 1975. Student nurse Heather Pearce dies during a training demonstration. Detective Chief Inspector Adam Dalgliesh is sent to investigate, accompanied by his partner DS Masterson. Pathologist Dr. Chopra confirms that Pearce was poisoned. Dalgliesh and Masterson take statements from the nurses, despite Matron’s attempts to intercede.

2.o: After Fallon’s death, Dalgliesh finds a library book in Fallon’s room and a letter in Pearce’s pigeonhole about a patient of Courtney-Briggs’ called Martin Dettinger, whose recent death on the hospital ward upset her. He later discovers rose spray, which Chopra confirms was used to poison Fallon. In the woods Dalgliesh is violently attacked.

3.o: March 1975. Dalgliesh is invited to Dorset by his old friend Father Michael, only to discover that he died a few days ago. Father Michael lived in a home for the disabled run by the enigmatic Wilfred, who has organised trips to Lourdes ever since he was miraculously cured there of a serious illness.

4.o: Wilfred announces that he will transfer the Grange to the Ridgewell Trust and hold a vote on whether he will carry on as spiritual adviser. Maggie threatens to down the ‘whole rotten place’. Despite Eric and Helen’s plot to usurp Wilfred, the majority of the Grange vote for Wilfred to stay, ensuring the Lourdes trips will continue.

5.o: May 1975. 8-year-old Darren and churchwarden Miss Wharton find two dead bodies in the vestry of St Matthew’s Church, Paddington, their throats slashed. One is Sir Paul Berowne, a baronet and recently-resigned Tory MP; the other a homeless man called Harry Mack. Dalgliesh is called in to investigate, accompanied by DS Masterson and his new DS Kate Miskin.

6.o: After the attack on Father Barnes while Halliwell was in custody, Dalgliesh brings Swayne and Lampart in for questioning. He discovers Lampart is having an affair with Lady Barbara, who reveals she is pregnant and thinks she will inherit everything. However, Lady Lavinia reveals that Sir Paul secretly changed his will at the last minute.

1.o: When a senior forensic biologist is found dead in his lab, Dalgliesh is called to East Anglia, where the murderer is lying in wait to strike again.

2.o: After another body is discovered, Dalgliesh and Miskin untangle a web of infidelities in this rural community, unearthing a killer with secrets to hide and tracks to cover.

3.o: Dalgliesh, Kate Miskin, and new D.S. Daniel Tarrant investigate the murder of an abrasive female defence barrister who successfully defended a shady young man on murder charges, only for him to begin dating her daughter.

4.o: As Dalgliesh's team sort out the complicated motives surrounding the victim's murder, they are running out of time to save her daughter from her dangerous fiancee.

1.o: For a year, people learn to live with the spheres without suffering any specific changes. Even with the alien-looking spheres floating all over the sky, the CSAT is what matters the most to seniors of Sungjin High School. When the exam is just around the corner, one of the spheres drops on a military camp for the first time, and more shocking news awaits them.

2.o: After spheres from the sky drop to the ground, military training begins for the students to ensure their safety. However, the students find it too demanding and have a difficult time. As students head to the shooting range to learn how to shoot, they get caught off guard and fall into a crisis. Meanwhile, a student gets killed by one of the spheres.

3.o: Two people from Class Two die. To prevent chaos, this news is not yet known throughout the entire school. After their deaths, students of Class Two get sick of all the hardcore training and try to escape school to go back to their homes. However, all their attempts go to waste and the biggest attack of the spheres begins.

4.o: The first vehicle gets attacked by a sphere and turned over. The soldier dies on the spot, and So-yeon gets badly injured. The students decide to leave the vehicle and find a shelter nearby. Soon, they find a construction site office where they can hide and rest. However, their peace doesn’t last long. Meanwhile, Lieutenant Lee goes against the order and steals a vehicle to rescue the students.

5.o: Chun-ho tries to make sure that the kids all survive so they can return safely to the camp. The kids after having gone through a common struggle begin to bond with each other. They also begin to learn more things about being a soldier. But there seems to be a more ominous order awaiting them from high command. Will they make it through another day?

6.o: After a heated encounter with the spheres, the group picked up some survivors. However, the heavily traumatized survivors have a hard time blending in and coping with the situation. Their outbursts and dire situation make the group rethink their morals and imperatives. Will they carry on with the mission or will they flee for their own safety?

7.o: The students of Class Two continue to fight and kill the spheres. They have a vote again to decide whether they will stay here together or go back home, and the result shows that there's disagreement growing among them. The next day, a group of students go somewhere to find parts to fix their radio. There, they run into strangers who ask for help.

8.o: Platoon Two encounter prisoners at the Yongwon Penitentiary. Since there are no prison guards, they have been locked up without any food supplies for a while now, and they threaten the kids to open the cell doors. One of the prisoners hands over a photo of his mother and begs Ae-seol to contact her for him. Meanwhile, at Yongdu Service Area, intruders barge in and look around the place.

9.o: While trying to save Bo-ra, Soo-chul sacrifices himself. Everyone wonders what they should do with his body when suddenly someone mentions that Soo-chul rigged voting. After finding out the truth behind the voting, they break into a fight. Then they find out why Soo-chul had to manipulate votes, which comes as a shock.

10.o: After aborting the mission, the kids walk for days but get to nowhere. However, they reach an amusement park and have fun as if it is their last. Meanwhile, Yeong-soo is not comfortable about walking away from the mission as he still believes the CSAT is not canceled. The end of the war draws near, but the kids have a long way left to survival.

1.t: The Ex-Con CEO and Ms. Mini
1.o: Ji-hwan, the former boss of the Bulldog Gang, is now the CEO of Thirsty Deer Corporation, a company that specializes in making all sorts of charcuterie. Eun-ha tries her best to become more famous as a WeTuber called Ms. Mini, who creates online video content for kids. The two seem like they would never belong in the same world, but by chance, they keep running into each other.

2.o: Ji-hwan ends up in the hospital because of Eun-ha. She comes to apologise, but she is still afraid of what Ji-hwan and his employees might do to her. Meanwhile, Director Lee and Mr. Ma at Macaron Soft upload a maliciously edited video of Ji-hwan’s employees. This time, Ji-hwan misunderstands the situation and blames Eun-ha.

3.o: After being publicly shamed for promoting a milk brand that caused havoc to customers, Eun-ha takes down her channel to repent. Ji-hwan watches from the sidelines and desires to get close to her. Meanwhile, Ye-na offers Eun-ha a job cleaning house to humiliate her, but Eun-ha swallows her pride and takes it.

4.o: Eun-ha gets fired and kicked out of her apartment. Having nowhere to go, she wanders around in the rain. She goes to Ji-hwan’s house to return his coat and ends up staying there for the night. Ji-hwan goes to Yoon-taek’s house to look for him, and Eun-ha tags along to talk to his little sister. Meanwhile, Hyun-woo also heads to Yoon-taek’s house, only to run into Ji-hwan and Eun-ha.

5.o: Hyun-woo tells Eun-ha who Ji-hwan really is, but she tries to defend Ji-hwan. Eun-ha runs into Hong-ki, who is on the run from Ji-hwan, but Hong-ki soon gets caught by the members of the Bulldog Gang. Meanwhile, Ji-hwan holds a welcoming party for Eun-ha, and Eun-ha invites someone over.

6.o: After having a drink last night, Eun-ha pretends that nothing happened between Ji-hwan and her. Ji-hwan seems quite proud and satisfied with his new nickname which Eun-ha gave. Meanwhile, Il-young and Mi-ho get doused with water when they walk down the street together. The members of the Bulldog Gang hurriedly head somewhere after getting an emergency call in the morning.

7.o: Eun-ha and Ji-hwan are finally rescued from the cold storage, and Eun-ha gets hospitalised. Mi-ho runs into Il-young on her way to visit Eun-ha, and there goes an awkward moment between them. Meanwhile, Hyun-woo tries to help Eun-ha find her childhood friend from her neighbourhood.

8.o: Ji-hwan recalls the day he buried a box that a childhood friend gave him eight years ago and how he got involved in a fight at a hotel ten years ago. Ji-hwan soon leaves home alone to save Yoon-taek, who is kept hostage. Meanwhile, Hyun Woo receives a tip about the drug deal and witnesses Ji-hwan at the scene.

9.o: Hyun-woo says that he can tell Eun-ha who the Hyun-woo she's looking for is. Eun-ha announces that she plans to move out of Ji-hwan's house. She starts to go out to find a place she'll move in. Meanwhile, Ji-hwan hears that Eun-ha is on a blind date in the company building and becomes curious about the blind date.

10.o: The members of the Bulldog Gang take Eun-ha and Ji-hwan on a trip with the intention of helping them make up with each other. Eun-ha goes for a walk in the woods alone and Ji-hwan starts to worry about her. Meanwhile, Mi-ho does a pregnancy test herself, but she ends up losing the test stick.

11.o: Eun-ha creates her new channel for kids online again, and she soon gets comments from two passionate fans. Il-young comes to visit Mi-ho's hair salon to tell her how he feels. Meanwhile, Ji-hwan witnesses an uninvited guest chatting with Man-ho and Jae-soo in his place. At a bakery, Dong-hui runs into someone who reminds him of his past that he doesn't wish to recall.

12.o: Hyun-woo is furious that he's forced to stop investigating the drug case involving Go Yang-hee. Il-young recalls how he ended up spending the night at Mi-ho's house. Ji-hwan tells Eun-ha about his childhood and relationship with Seo Tae-pyeong. Dong-hui can't stop thinking about his time with Seung-hui.

13.o: Eun-ha is convinced that she has finally found Hyun-woo whom she has been desperately looking for. Dong-hui is intimidated by a man who causes a commotion in the company and recalls the old days he spent with Seung-hui. Mi-ho finds out that Il-young knew about her secret all along. Meanwhile, Tae-pyung makes an offer to Ji-hwan.

14.o: Il-young announces to the gang that he’ll get married to Mi-ho and that she’s pregnant with his child. Seo Tae-pyeong barges into Ji-hwan’s company with his men and claims to settle the debt. Fearing Seo Tae-pyeong’s retribution, the company’s board members resign. Meanwhile, Eun-ha gets attacked by Go Yang-hee while wrapping up the offline event.

15.o: Ji-hwan faces a significant dilemma when he realises that, despite his strong desire to be with Eun-ha, his presence might actually put her safety at risk. On the other hand, Eun-ha is unconcerned about the dangers that might follow Ji-hwan and simply wants to be with him. Ji-hwan feels he needs to complete one last task before making any decisions about Eun-ha, but it might already be too late.

16.o: Ji-hwan is critically injured while attempting to rescue his father and is now in a coma due to severe bleeding. The only option is to wait for him to regain consciousness. Eun-ha remains by his side, caring for him and hoping for his recovery. Meanwhile, Tae-pyung, who has been arrested, refuses to confess voluntarily, though he does show some emotional response upon learning about his son's condition.

1.o: تستعد "نزهات" وابنتاها لاستقبال أول نزيل حقيقي منذ سنوات، لكن "كان" الساحر يخفيّ أكبر مما يُظهر.

2.o: فيما تتنافس "غولتان" و"ندريت" لجذب انتباه "كان"، يُظهر كادر الفندق ونزلاؤه اهتمامهم الخاص والمختلف في الغريب الوسيم.

3.o: تأخذ "غولتان" "كان" في جولة حول البلدة مما يثير الأقاويل بين سكان البلدة. في حين تجرب "ندريت" طريقة نفسية جديدة لحل المشاكل بينها وبين شقيقتها.

4.o: بعد كوارث الليلة السابقة، تستشير "غولتان" عرّافة غامضة، فيما تقنع "ندريت" "كان" بالذهاب معها إلى فصل "الحياة الصحية للعمر الجديد".

5.o: يختفي "كان"، وتشرع الشقيقتان في رحلة بحث بين أروقة الفندق والبلدة وحتى العوالم الروحية. في الجانب الآخر، يقضي "كان" الليلة مع شخص مميز.

6.o: تُشعل عودة "مهتاب" سلسلة من سوء الفهم، وبينما تنتشر الشائعات في أنحاء البلدة، ينغمس "كان" في وهج شعبيته الجديدة ويغرق فيها أكثر مما ينبغي.

7.o: في ضوء ما اكتشفه مؤخرًا، يبدأ "كان" في محاولة التودد للأخوات المنهمكات في التخطيط لخطوباتهن، مما يحوّل إعجاب "مهتاب" به إلى اشمئزاز.

8.o: تشعر "غولتان" و"ندريت" بالرضا وتحقيق الذات في رسالتيهما الجديدتين في الحياة، بينما يمضي "كان" بمكانته المعلنة "المختار" إلى تصعيد الأمور نحو فوضى غير معهودة.

1.t: We Have Always Lived in the Castle
1.o: بينما تنصب الأعين على زوجها بسبب علاقاته العاطفية السابقة مع طالباته، تنجذب "إم" إلى زميلها الجديد والجذاب "فلاديمير"، الذي يصغرها بعدة أعوام.

2.o: تلجأ "إم" إلى أساليب متطرفة لتأجيل جلسة استماع "جون"، بينما تتوطد علاقتها بـ"فلاديمير" عبر تشارك الشراب وتبادل المحادثات العفوية في أروقة الحرم الجامعي.

3.t: Enormous Changes at the Last Minute
3.o: تحاول "إم" كسب ود "سينثيا" من خلال استضافة حفلة مسبح، فيما تكشف "سيد" لوالديها حقيقة ما يجري.

4.o: ينضم "سيد" للمساعدة في دعم قضية "جون". وفي هذه الأثناء، تلجأ "إم" إلى تدابير يائسة لتأجيل جلسة الاستماع، وتُجري محادثة صريحة بشكل مفاجئ مع "سينثيا".

5.o: تفكّر "أم" مليًا في أمر إيموجي مبهم وصلها، وتخطّط للقاء ولكن بدوافع خفية... وسرعان ما تزداد الأمور سوءًا مع محاولة "سيد" للحيلولة دون شهادة "لايلا".

6.t: Because It Is Bitter and Because It Is My Heart
6.o: في مواجهة تداعيات تصرفات "جون" الطائشة والمعاملة الجافة من زملائها، تعرض "إم" المسألة على عموم طلاب الكلية بشكل مباشر.

7.ar: كل ما يرتفع يجب أن يتقارب
7.o: يتسنّى لـ"إم" لقاء "فلاديمير" وحدهما أخيرًا، لكن مشاعرها تباغتها حين تدرك أنها لا تودّ لموعد غدائهما معًا أن ينتهي.

8.o: تبدأ التعقيدات بالظهور في الكوخ الريفي المنعزل الذي تقيم فيه "إم" و"فلاد" حين يبدآن بمراجعة كتاباتهما وزواجيهما ومستقبلهما الغامض.
